citation: Hirshorn, S.R., Voss, L.D. & Bromley, L.K. (2017) NASA Systems Engineering Handbook, NASA/SP-2016-6105 Rev 2, Section 2.5 (p. 14), Section 4.3 (pp. 82-83), Section 6.8 Decision Analysis (pp. 193-201) and Appendix B Glossary (p. 235).

decision_analysis_steps: Understand the decision to be made and its mission context
Define decision criteria and mandatory constraints (Flight Rules)
Identify alternative solutions covering the decision space
Evaluate alternatives against criteria (power, consumables, risk, crew time, schedule)
Record risks, benefits, dissent and decision rationale
Select and commit the recommended alternative
decision_analysis_report_sections: Risks and benefits of each option
Dissent and how dissent was addressed
values.trade_study_definition: Devising alternative means to meet functional requirements, evaluating these alternatives in terms of measures of effectiveness and system cost, and ranking the alternatives according to clear criteria.

derived.name: trade_card_columns
value: Consumables (Air A, Water W, Rations R, Crop C, Plant H)
Risk (Exposure Z, Slope deg, Pressure kPa/%)
derived.formula: Section 6.8 Decision Matrix mapped to Aurora habitat levers

boundary: NASA engineering methodology simplified for 10-12-year-old learners into a side-by-side Preview A/B Trade Card with a one-sentence Decision Rationale.
